headline: From Shortage To Glut: Crude Sinks To Key Technical Support As Hormuz Reopens
summary: WTI crude fell to its 200-day moving average as a U.S.-Iran deal to reopen Hormuz nears. Analysts are warning the glut may deepen into 2027.

headline: Nasdaq 100 Rallies, Oil Sinks To $75 On Iran Peace Deal: Stock Market Today
summary: Stocks staged a broad rebound Thursday as a signed U.S.-Iran peace deal sank oil and an Intel-Apple chip pact powered semis.

headline: Oil Stocks Trade As If Iran War Never Happened: 10 Falling Knives To Watch
summary: The two largest energy ETFs have erased their entire Iran war rally as the Strait of Hormuz reopens. The biggest spring winners are now the worst losers.
